metadata.canon_status: non_canonical. Prices are candidate manual inputs; nothing here is canon until Ajit approves it, and approved values go to data/knowledge/business/** in a separate canon pass.
metadata.range_convention: Numbers are {low, high} source ranges. A null price or lifetime means missing: the configurator lists it as a gap and leaves it out of totals.
metadata.vat_note: Price bases differ (incl. VAT, excl. VAT, not stated) and are recorded per item. No VAT is added or removed.
metadata.currency_note: Each region uses its own currency (EUR, INR). No exchange rate is applied inside a build.
metadata.reliability_fields: AGENTS.md 6A: source_tier, source_gate + reason, confidence + reason, corroboration {status, source_ids}.

air_lpm_per_kg_feed_day.unit: L air per minute per kg feed per day
air_lpm_per_kg_feed_day.source_gate_reason: SRAC 453 rules of thumb: 3 cfm per lb daily feed (blown air, = 187 L/min per kg) and 249 L/min per kg (airlift).
air_lpm_per_kg_feed_day.confidence_reason: Rule of thumb, not a DO model; not aeration adequacy.

raft_air_share_of_fish_air.derivation: UVI hydroponic blower 0.75 kW / fish blower 1.12 kW
raft_air_share_of_fish_air.source_gate_reason: Derived from blower power ratings; assumes equal blower efficiency.
raft_air_share_of_fish_air.confidence_reason: Power ratio used as an airflow ratio.

review_flags.flag: SRAC 454 and the UVI design paper list a 1 hp plant blower, but the UVI costing (Heidemann & Bailey) lists 2 hp. At 2 hp the ratio would be 1.33 (derived). Value not changed.

raft_trough_width_m.source_gate_reason: Repo research pack summary of extension guides.
raft_trough_width_m.confidence_reason: Common range; drives liner area only.

review_flags.flag: 0.30-0.35 m sits at or above the primary sources: FAO 589 gives 15-30 cm (30 cm only for large fruiting crops), SRAC 5007 gives 6-12 in (15-30 cm). Re-check where 0.35 came from.

mbbr_loading_kg_feed_per_m3_day.confidence_reason: Design range from SRAC 453 via the distilled pack.

separate_biofilter_needed_for.note: DWC rafts nitrify when solids are removed (canon raft_waste_treatment_capacity_feed_equivalent). Media beds are their own biofilter in simple systems, but are listed here because the configurator does not credit media nitrification yet; remove media_bed to credit it.

feeding_rate_architecture_factor.note: SRAC 454 via the distilled pack: gravel and NFT systems should use about 25% of the raft feeding rate ratio.
feeding_rate_architecture_factor.source_gate_reason: Read through the distilled research pack.
feeding_rate_architecture_factor.confidence_reason: One sentence in one fact sheet; strongly changes fish output for NFT and media beds.

makeup_water_fraction_per_day.source_gate_reason: UVI: add make-up water daily, about 1.5% of system volume.
makeup_water_fraction_per_day.confidence_reason: Tropical site; evaporation differs in a Dutch greenhouse.
makeup_water_fraction_per_day.cross_check: SRAC 454 says less than 2% per day in closed aquaponics.
